svg.text: THE ATLANTIC LIFELINE: FEEDING ISLAND BRITAIN (1939–1945)
How Merchant Convoys, Rationing, Dig for Victory & Bletchley Park Codebreakers Worked Together

g.text: Allied merchant ship convoys (wheat, meat & oil)
Allied coastal patrol aircraft range (protecting ships)
Bletchley Park decoding U-boat Enigma signals
Island Britain imported two-thirds of its food by sea.
Rationing & Dig for Victory saved cargo space while
Bletchley Park cracked Naval Enigma so convoys could
steer safely around U-boat wolf packs!
